summary: Temporary credentialed query access to production logs for cross-tenant incident correlation
description: Issue summary: Security/Incidents team requests time-limited, credentialed query access to production logging and tracing data to correlate an unusual error spike affecting multiple tenants. Impact: Can't complete correlation analysis from aggregated metrics alone; may delay mitigation. Requestor: Incident Response (IR) runbook step triggered by on-call; primary contact Aaron Schmidt (IR Lead).
justification: Root-cause correlation requires joining request traces with per-request metadata across tenant routing and fallback events. The minimal access window will allow IR to confirm whether a recent routing rule change caused late-stage model fallbacks and increased tokenization errors for a small subset of customers.
access_scope: Read-only queries against logs and trace spans. Scope: logs.indexes=[inference-requests*, serving-runtime-logs*, router-traces*]; time window: 2026-03-08T22:00Z to 2026-03-09T06:00Z (8h). Tenant filter: only include tenant identifiers A12345, B23456; exclude full customer payloads. No raw model outputs unless absolutely required and only after redaction approval.
data_minimization: 1) Restrict queries to hashed session_id and request_id where possible. 2) Exclude or redact message contents and embeddings; pull only metadata fields (latency_ms, route, model_version, kv_cache_hit). 3) Any PII encountered must be redacted immediately and logged in audit trail. 4) IR will not export full traces off-platform without additional compliance sign-off.
security_controls: - Short-lived credential issued via Vault with one-time session token. - Access only from corporate jumpbox with enforced MFA. - Read-only role bound to queries with enforced result row limits and no exports. - Live recording of query session to secure evidence store.
audit_requirements: All query text, start/end timestamps, and identity of operator must be recorded. Query results exceeding 100 rows require explicit annotation and justification. Store audit artifact link in ticket comments. Any discovery of customer PII triggers immediate escalation to Compliance and Legal.
steps_to_execute: 1) Requestor submits signed approval from approvers listed above.
2) Security ops will provision Vault token scoped to log-read role for 4 hours.
3) SRE will publish temporary ACL in observability cluster and verify row limits.
4) IR will run a predefined set of parameterized queries (see attached query set link) and paste results into secure ephemeral workspace.
5) After window closes, Security ops will revoke credentials and produce a usage audit report.
investigation_notes: (2026-03-11) Initial triage: metric spike at 2026-03-09T00:40Z linked to increased fallback rate on rw-chat-13b for two tenants. Cannot correlate with router config from metrics alone. (2026-03-11) Hypothesis: a new routing rule rollout may have mis-matched model capabilities and caused excess tokenization exceptions. Need per-request trace join to confirm. Proposed minimal query set prepared: join on request_id -> check fallback path, tokenization_error flag, and kv_cache_hit. Prepared by Marco Hernandez.
